questions.question: Did the west sidewalk record more total cyclist crossings than the east sidewalk over the entire tracking period?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('seattle_fremont_bridge_bicycle_counter.csv')
west = df['Fremont Bridge Sidewalks, south of N 34th St Cyclist West Sidewalk'].sum()
east = df['Fremont Bridge Sidewalks, south of N 34th St Cyclist East Sidewalk'].sum()
result = 'yes' if west > east else 'no'

questions.question: Did any single hour record 1,100 or more total bicycle crossings on the Fremont Bridge?
